items.headline: High-severity advisory affecting Nexus Repository ≤ 3.94 (sample)
items.so_what: If they claim on-prem is safer: "Both models carry advisories — what matters is time-to-detect. JFrog Xray flags known-affected packages in your graph the moment an advisory lands, with contextual impact analysis." Do not name their specific CVE unprompted.

evidence.quote: Improper authentication in Nexus Repository allows bypass of access controls prior to 3.95.

items.headline: Nexus 3.95 adds Cargo registry support (sample)
items.so_what: If they raise "we now support Cargo too": "Format support is table stakes — ask them about Cargo malware scanning and license curation on those crates. JFrog Curation blocks a malicious crate before it enters your build; a registry that only hosts the format doesn't."

evidence.quote: Added: hosted, proxy and group repositories for the Cargo (crates.io) format.

items.headline: New financial-services case study on Sonatype's customer page (sample)
items.so_what: If they cite this reference in a banking deal: "Ask what that bank did about binary-level runtime exposure and multi-site replication — governance of open-source metadata is one layer. JFrog offers the artifact store, scanning and distribution as one system." Named-account overlap flagged to the competitive desk.

evidence.quote: A top-20 European bank standardised its open-source governance on Sonatype.

items.headline: Sonatype now listed in a major cloud marketplace with committed-spend eligibility (sample)
items.so_what: If procurement pushes marketplace drawdown: "JFrog is available through the same marketplace with equivalent committed-spend treatment — the procurement path is not a differentiator here. Bring the conversation back to platform breadth." Confirm current listing status with deal desk before quoting.

evidence.quote: Available in the marketplace; counts toward your committed cloud spend.

items.headline: Nexus 3.95 deprecates Java 11 runtime; end-of-support dated (sample)
items.so_what: Migration angle for two accounts on Java 11: "Their upgrade forces a runtime migration anyway — that's the moment to evaluate alternatives rather than re-platform in place. Offer a side-by-side proof-of-concept while they're already touching the deployment."

evidence.quote: Java 11 is deprecated and support will be removed in a future release.

items.headline: EU CRA vulnerability-reporting obligations now dated (sample)
items.so_what: When procurement raises CRA readiness: "CRA makes SBOM generation and vulnerability reporting a buying requirement, not a nice-to-have. JFrog produces signed SBOMs and full-graph vulnerability context in one place — bring compliance and security into the same conversation."

evidence.quote: Manufacturers must report actively exploited vulnerabilities within 24 hours of awareness.
